notablePrerequisites: An additional land card in hand.
description:
Play a land.
Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling token that is also a Forest.
Repeat step 2 any number of times.
Activate Ashnod's Altar any number of times by sacrificing Sporemound and any number of Saprolings, adding any amount of colorless mana.
